privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.body:
## Introduction

VEIN Fan Hub ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you visit our website.

## Information We Collect

We may collect information that you provide directly to us, such as when you contact us or interact with our website. This may include your name, email address, and any messages you send to us.

## How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services, respond to your inquiries, and communicate with you about our website and services.

## Data Security

We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

## Third-Party Services

Our website may contain links to third-party websites or services. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these third parties. We encourage you to review their privacy policies.

## Cookies

We may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience on our website. You can control cookie settings through your browser preferences.

## Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at [wyong@veingame.net](mailto:wyong@veingame.net).

## Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last Updated" date.

about-us.title: About Us
about-us.body:
## Welcome to VEIN Fan Hub

VEIN Fan Hub is an unofficial community resource dedicated to the VEIN survival game. We are passionate fans who have created this website to help fellow survivors navigate the challenges of the game.

## Our Mission

Our mission is to provide comprehensive, accurate, and up-to-date information about VEIN game. We archive gameplay notes, hardware targets, and patch updates so survivors can track Early Access progress and improve their gaming experience.

## What We Offer

We provide a wide range of resources including:

-   Comprehensive game guides and walkthroughs
-   Detailed wiki with game mechanics and features
-   Complete items database with stats and information
-   Interactive maps and location guides
-   Community-driven content and updates

## Our Commitment

We are committed to maintaining the accuracy and quality of our content. Our team regularly updates information based on game patches, community feedback, and verified gameplay data.

## Disclaimer

VEIN Fan Hub is an independent, fan-operated website. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Ramjet Studios or the official VEIN game. All game-related content is used for informational purposes only.

## Contact Us

If you have questions, suggestions, or feedback, please feel free to contact us at [wyong@veingame.net](mailto:wyong@veingame.net). We appreciate your support and contributions to the VEIN community.

## Thank You

Thank you for visiting VEIN Fan Hub. We hope our resources help you survive and thrive in the world of VEIN!

contact-us.title: Contact Us
contact-us.body:
## Get in Touch

We'd love to hear from you! Whether you have questions, suggestions, feedback, or just want to say hello, please don't hesitate to contact us.

## Email

For general inquiries, please email us at: [wyong@veingame.net](mailto:wyong@veingame.net)

## What We Can Help With

We're here to assist with:

-   Questions about our website or content
-   Suggestions for improvements or new features
-   Reporting errors or outdated information
-   Copyright or legal inquiries
-   Partnership or collaboration opportunities
-   General feedback about VEIN Fan Hub

## Response Time

We strive to respond to all inquiries within 2-3 business days. Please be patient as we review and respond to your message.

## Community Contributions

If you'd like to contribute content, corrections, or updates to our website, please contact us with details about your contribution. We appreciate all community support!

## Privacy

Any information you provide in your correspondence will be kept confidential and used only for the purpose of responding to your inquiry. Please review our [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy) for more information.

## Thank You

Thank you for your interest in VEIN Fan Hub. We look forward to hearing from you!
